content.comment_body: I am looking to connect 5 PT100 sensors to a [product_name]. Is it possible for the [product_name] to support 3 [product_name] modules for PT100 sensors simultaneously?
Hello [user_name], It should be feasible. Refer to the manual: [url] See Chapter 2.1. Best regards, [user_name]

Dear friend, I encountered a similar issue before. My solution involved using a PT100 multiplexer connected to the [company_name] [product_name], which enables connection of up to 16 PT100 sensors to the [company_name] [product_name]. Alternatively, you can use multiple [product_name] modules from [company_name], but you would need more units and that increases costs. You can find more information on the internet: [url] If you require further details, feel free to contact me at [user_name]@[company_name].es Thank you. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing options for expanding PT100 sensor connections to a [product_name], weighing the possibilities between adding multiple [product_name] expansion modules and using external multiplexers. The conversation reflects considerations about scalability and overall cost when increasing sensor inputs beyond the module's basic capacities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] system to allow expansion with multiple [product_name] modules for additional sensor connections, or for there to be a cost-effective integrated solution that supports monitoring several PT100 sensors.
